command: set -euo pipefail; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; bash scripts/android/ensure-alpha-signing.sh; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile build; pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android; printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties; (cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew --no-daemon assembleDebug)
